role_attribution_candidates.original_claim_text: 18. An apparatus comprising: a memory; a processing device operatively coupled to the memory, the processing device to: provide data indicative of presence of a potential typographical error in a work to a user via a graphical user interface, wherein the work comprises a plurality of words; receive input identifying the potential typographical error that is an author-intended string for the work, the input comprising an indicator that specifies that the potential typographical error is an author-intended string for the work, wherein the author-intended string comprises at least one of an author-intended spelling of one or more words, an author-intended punctuation, an author-intended grammar, or an author-intended use of one or more foreign language words; determine one or more parameters to associate with the author-intended string, wherein the one or more parameters comprises at least one of an author associated with the work, a title associated the work, a topic associated with the work, or a publisher associated with the work; and provide feedback for the work to a server computing machine, the feedback comprising identification of the author-intended string and the one or more parameters associated with the author-intended string, wherein the server computing machine is to: combine the feedback with additional feedback from a plurality of users for the work and one or more additional works to generate a combined feedback; sort the combined feedback based on the one or more parameters associated with the author-intended string to generate a sorted feedback; and update, based on the sorted feedback, a reference using the author-intended string.

limitations_zh: 本结果为AI辅助逐来源语义审阅，不是独立人工金标准；分类依赖所声明的类/实例粒度。
只审计第二轮既有20篇索引中的可见原chunk、原抽取与实际图邻边；原文范围为已索引的标题、摘要及Claims，未额外读取完整说明书或新语料，未调用模型API，也未进行新的检索/生成传播测试。
共享节点产生跨专利邻接不等于已观察到错误跨文档推理；边的source_id和file_path应保持作用域。
是否可把server操作作为整机功能间接概括存在粒度解释空间；目前将三个显式主语不一致的边列为qualified_role_attribution_candidate，不计为已证明跨专利错误边。
